author: GTADossier
quote: Looks good, but thats about it, just millions of polygons, no real essence of GTA, they've taken elements from man hunt, bully, god of war, its more like a linear progress game rather than open world, an open world where you are limited. Its no longer a sandbox. Frankly, they've not built a GTA, its a tightly controlled life simulator with the illusion of a free open world.
